# Karouselmaker

> Karouselmaker helps founders and marketers organically promote a product or service through value-first Instagram and TikTok carousels that do not feel like ads.

## What it does

Karouselmaker helps founders, marketers, and small businesses turn a niche, product, or service into value-first social carousels. A project keeps the offer, audience, brand context, templates, and generated posts together. Users can paste a public website or describe an offer manually, choose a topic, then generate an editable title, slide sequence, caption, and hashtags.

Each carousel is designed around a clear hook, useful information, a practical payoff, and a fitting call to action. The post earns attention with audience value first, then naturally bridges to the user’s product or service. Users can choose built-in template collections or a single template, edit slide copy and imagery, then download a ZIP with slides in posting order alongside copy ready to paste.

## Supported formats

- Instagram carousel posts
- TikTok Photo Mode / carousel posts
- A title, caption, hashtags, and export-ready slides
- Feed, square, and story-ready placements

## Product boundaries

- Karouselmaker is a focused organic-promotion workspace rather than a general graphic design editor.
- Direct TikTok posting is currently an admin-only test feature; users download post-ready files for normal publishing.
- It does not guarantee reach, sales, followers, or conversions.
- Users review generated copy, images, and claims before publishing.
